widgetManual.pushButton: Push button — drives a BOOL variable. Configurable behaviours: momentary (the variable is 1 while the button is held), SET (forces to 1), RESET (forces to 0), toggle (inverts the value on each press).
widgetManual.toggleSwitch: Switch — reads and inverts a BOOL variable on click.
widgetManual.indicator: Indicator light — shows the state of a BOOL variable (off = grey, on = green).
widgetManual.numericDisplay: Numeric display — shows the value of a numeric variable. Options: unit (text suffix) and number of decimals.
widgetManual.gauge: Gauge — a progress bar bound to a numeric variable. Options: min, max and orientation (horizontal / vertical).
widgetManual.numericInput: Numeric input — an input field bound to a numeric variable. In simulation, type a value and confirm with Enter or by clicking elsewhere to write it into the variable. Options: min and max.
widgetManual.text: Text — free text. Options: content, font size, colour, alignment (left / centre / right).
widgetManual.rectangle: Rectangle — a rectangular shape. Options: fill colour, stroke colour and width, corner radius.
widgetManual.ellipse: Ellipse — an oval or circular shape. Options: fill colour, stroke colour and width. The "Link width and height" box (Dimensions section) locks the current ratio.
widgetManual.line: Line — a solid-colour segment. Options: colour, width and orientation (horizontal / vertical).
